{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Frost-blue wool tweed blazer cut tailored with a nipped waist in deep navy (#1b2b3a), high-rise slim-fit trousers in dark charcoal wool (#1f2529).  
Point-toe leather pumps with a moderate heel in polished black (#0d0d0d).  
Silver geometric pendant necklace and a structured beige tote bag (#e8e0c7).  
This outfit works because the frost-blue tweed provides warmth against the snowy morning weather while the dark charcoal trousers maintain a professional silhouette suitable for an office setting. The tailored blazer adds structure without being overly formal, striking the perfect balance for a neat business dress code during autumn work hours. Silver and neutral tones complement her warm undertones visible in her skin tone, ensuring she looks polished and ready to walk the twenty-minute commute to the office."}
